description: This Java source file defines the SubUpdater class, which manages local subscriptions in a pub/sub system using Akka actors and distributed data. It handles subscription requests, unsubscriptions, and synchronization with distributed data, including acknowledgements and consistency management.

classes.name: SubUpdater
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractUpdater that manages local subscriptions, handles distributed data updates, and coordinates acknowledgements in a pub/sub system using Akka actors.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns a Props object for instantiating the SubUpdater actor with specified configuration, subscriber, and distributed data.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, updates internal subscription state, and manages actor watching.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Handles unsubscription requests, updates internal subscription state, and manages actor unwatching.

methods.name: ddataOpSuccess
methods.description: Processes successful distributed data operations, sends acknowledgements, and resets change flags.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs periodic updates to distributed data and manages state transitions.

methods.name: flushSubAcks
methods.description: Sends subscription acknowledgements to their respective senders.

methods.name: performDDataOp
methods.description: Performs distributed data operations such as updating or removing subscriber data, and returns a snapshot of current subscriptions.
